scope: Following the pull-down of a Flag–GSDME fusion protein, the immunoprecipitants were analysed by mass spectrometry.

The cells were collected, lysed and immunoprecipitated with isotype control of IgG or anti-FLAG conjugated to protein G agarose (Roche) at 4 ºC overnight. Then, the immunoprecipitants were run on SDS-PAGE gel. After Coomassie blue staining, the protein bands were collected for mass spectrometry analysis.
